name: The Lower Reaches
desc: Floors 1 to 3: the Old Toll Level, the Flooded Stair and the Silk Gallery. Each floor must be cleared before the next opens.

name: The Wilds
desc: Floors 4 to 6: the Greenwood, the Mire and the Warren. A goblin war band holds the wilds above the Lower Reaches; its warchief waits at the bottom of the Warren.
